responsibility: Provides the HP-UX 10 operating-system configuration for the PA backend, refining the generic HP-UX target with this release’s preprocessor environment and driver specs. It defines the HP-UX 10 builtin macros and standards-mode feature macros seen by system headers, sets linker and library specs for shared/static links, profiling, `rdynamic`, DCE threads, and `dld`, chooses thread-model reporting, and points GCC at HP-UX 10 tool and startup-file directories while enabling use of the newer HP assembler.
same_name_distinction: HP-UX 10 OS configuration header for the PA port: unlike pa-hpux10.opt, which only declares the `threads` driver option, this file consumes that option in CPP/LINK/LIB/THREAD_MODEL specs and defines the HP-UX 10 preprocessor macros, linker/library behavior, tool paths, and assembler selection.
